items.title: Parallel Problem Solving from Nature – PPSN XIX
ZX-Calculus for Quantum Circuits
items.description:
ZX-Calculus has emerged as one of the most powerful frameworks for representing and optimizing quantum circuits—bridging the gap between abstract theory and real-world implementation. This book offers a complete and coding-driven introduction to ZX-Calculus, guiding readers from the mathematical and physical foundations of quantum circuits to the advanced techniques of diagrammatic reasoning and circuit optimization. Beginning with qubits, gates, and entanglement, you will gradually go through the principles of ZX-Calculus, spider rules, and diagrammatic equivalences that form the foundation of this visual and rigorous language. 
 Building upon this foundation, the book takes a hands-on approach to applying ZX-Calculus in modern quantum development environments. You will explore open-source tools such as PyZX, Quantomatic, and ZX-Optimizer; learn to translate quantum circuits into diagrams and back; and perform real-world circuit optimizations that reduce resource costs for NISQ devices. Advanced chapters extend these ideas to phase gadgets, Clifford hierarchies, and measurement-based computation, while the final section dives into circuit fabrication from ZX nodes—linking theory directly to implementation. 
 Whether you are a student, researcher, or professional developer, this book equips you with the theoretical insight, coding skills, and practical tools to design, optimize, and deploy efficient quantum circuits using the power of ZX-Calculus. 
 What You Will Learn: 
 
 Translate complex quantum operations into intuitive diagrammatic forms and simplify them through step-by-step transformations 
 Integrate ZX-Calculus concepts into modern quantum computing workflows and frameworks 
 Master the fundamentals of ZX-Calculus and apply ZX-based methods for large-scale circuit optimization 
 Discover how ZX-Calculus can be used in fermionic tensor networks, quantum error correction, and quantum machine learning

 Researchers, Developers and Po

items.title: React Native for Mobile Development
items.description:
Modern mobile applications demand more than working code. They require thoughtful architecture, outstanding performance, maintainability, security, and the ability to evolve as products grow. Through real-world examples, proven architectural patterns, and industry best practices, you'll learn how to build applications that are designed for long-term success. From crafting intuitive user interfaces and integrating APIs to implementing scalable architectures, optimizing performance, and establishing robust testing strategies, this book guides you through every stage of the development journey. Along the way, you'll gain practical insights drawn from real-world engineering challenges and enterprise-scale applications.Whether you're a developer taking your first steps into React Native, a mobile engineer looking to deepen your expertise, or a technical leader building enterprise applications, this book provides the knowledge, tools, and confidence to create exceptional mobile experiences. By the end of this book, you'll be equipped to design, build, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality React Native applications with confidence. 

What You'll Learn 
 
 Master React Native fundamentals and modern development workflow 
 Build responsive, reusable, and production-ready user interfaces 
 Implement navigation and API integrations 
 Apply scalable architecture and engineering best practices 
 Optimize performance for enterprise-grade applications 
 Build reliable applications through testing and quality engineering 
 Deploy and maintain applications across iOS and Android platforms 
 Best practice for scalable, maintainable, and high-performance mobile apps 
 

Who This Book Is For 

From beginners to advanced, this book introduces developers who have experience with JavaScript but are new or not acquainted with React Native or ReactJS.

items.title: Cognitive Semantic Communication for Future Wireless Communications
items.description:
The rapid evolution of 6G networks demands communication systems that go beyond data transmission toward intelligent understanding. Semantic communication (SemCom) represents a paradigm shift from transmitting bits to transmitting meaning. By integrating artificial intelligence, knowledge graphs, and reasoning capabilities, cognitive SemCom further enables networks to infer, interpret, and deliver only task-relevant information, thereby achieving higher efficiency, robustness, and explainability than classical SemCom architectures. 

This book provides a comprehensive overview of cognitive SemCom, from fundamental theories to practical implementations. It explores how structured knowledge can be used for semantic encoding, reasoning, compression, and robust signal recovery under interference, model mismatch, and adversarial attacks. Core topics include UAV-enabled cognitive SemCom systems, multi-user and multi-modal resource allocation, and cross-layer semantic security. The book also demonstrates how semantic communication can support low-latency, energy-efficient, and intelligence-native 6G systems. 

Designed for researchers, engineers, and graduate students in wireless communications, signal processing, and artificial intelligence, this book bridges communication theory with machine intelligence. Readers will gain a deep understanding of how cognitive abilities transform communication from symbol transmission to meaning exchange, and how these innovations enable future intelligent networks.

items.title: Oracle Integration Cookbook for Oracle ERP Cloud
items.description:
The book begins by establishing a strong foundation, introducing OIC concepts, integration types, adapters, connections, fault handling, notifications, mappings, JavaScript, XSLT, projects, and monitoring capabilities. It then dives deep into the heart of Oracle ERP Cloud integrations, covering REST, SOAP, FTP, ATP databases, Object Storage, Visual Builder, BI Publisher, UCM Web Center, and ERP Business Events. Readers are guided through detailed, step-by-step demos including FBDI-based integrations, callback patterns, event-driven architectures, advanced REST and SOAP use cases, file-based processing, parallel and data-stitch activities, massive data loads, and delta-based processing between runs. 

The final chapters and appendices provide advanced demos, troubleshooting techniques, Postman and SoapUI usage, reusable samples, and best practices, making the book an invaluable reference for both day-to-day delivery work and long-term architecture design. By the end of this book, readers will not only understand how Oracle ERP Cloud integrations work, but will also have the confidence and practical knowledge to design, build, monitor, and optimize robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions using Oracle Integration Cloud. 

 You Will: 
 
 Design, build, and monitor end-to-end integrations between Oracle ERP Cloud and external systems using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) 
 Implement and troubleshoot real-world integration scenarios using REST, SOAP, FTP, FBDI, ERP Business Events, ATP databases, Object Storage, and Visual Builder 
 Apply advanced integration patterns including callbacks, event-driven flows, parallel processing, massive data loads, delta processing, fault handling, and production best practices 
 

This book is for : Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) developers, Oracle ERP Cloud consultants and integration architects

items.title: Arduino Assembly Language
items.description:
This book explores how to use Assembly Language within your Arduino sketches, directly from the Arduino IDE, without any external tools. By learning to write low-level code, you’ll gain the ability to reduce sketch size, increase execution speed, and achieve precise timing control, especially useful for tasks like bit-banging communication protocols. It’s designed to be both educational and practical, helping developers and makers to reduce the size of their sketches, increase the speed of execution, and to get a much better understanding of how the Arduino hardware works. With a focus on clarity and hands-on examples, it’s ideal for developers and makers who want to push their Arduino projects further and gain deeper insight into microcontroller programming. 

 What You'll Learn 

• How to code in Assembly for speed, code size and exact timings. • How to write libraries for use with Assembly (and C++ for some of the libraries). • How to interact with all the hardware features of the ATmega328P, from Assembly Language. • What to avoid and other pitfalls. 

 Who Is This Book For 

Everyone with an interest in the Arduino boards based on the ATmega328P. All levels but a passing understanding of some programming languages would be helpful.

The DCS-CI series has its origins in the DCS-Water conferences started in 2024, which focused specifically on the cybersecurity challenges facing water and wastewater utilities.

items.title: Immersive Technology Unveiled
items.description:
Immersive Technology is revolutionizing the present and future. It includes virtual reality (VR), augmented reality (AR), and mixed reality (MR) to extend reality by engaging the handler in a virtual environment through applications in domains such as web application, healthcare, transportation, construction, gaming, etc. This book focuses on immersive technology where VR headsets create a simulator environment and an individual immerse into it to get the experience of completely different reality. 


The book provides knowledge about the fundamentals and scope of VR, AR and MR. It discusses machine learning, artificial intelligence, internet of things, cloud computing, and many other pillars that plays a vital role in the revolution of immersive technology. This book also discusses some case studies that will be beneficial for industries that are dealing with smart wearable gadgets. 


Readers will learn a complete perspective of immersive technologies from the technical details and real-life use-cases to its social, cultural, and business contexts. 


 


 You Will 

 
 Explains through examples along with code how to practically develop AR, VR, and MR applications 
 Shows how interactive technology can interact with physical movements 
 Demonstrates how to provide more intuitive and interaction-less experiences within immersive spaces 
 


 


 Who Is This Book For 


Beginner to Intermediate level readers with interest in AR development would benefit from this book.
